D1_sheet_thrust_as_sail_mechanism.rule: amendment 1: accept if H_p/(2r) > 1.5 AND H_p(sigma=20kPa) >= 1.5 H_p(sigma=0) at >= 2 of the 4 operating points

measured.cases: D = 3 m, h_i = 0.25 m, particle budget 800, 4000 steps, seed 0, D = 1 m flume (log: logs/exp_thrust2.log)

D1_sheet_thrust_as_sail_mechanism.reason: H_p/(2r) > 1.5 in 0 of 4 points and the paired height ratio reaches 1.5 in only 1 of 4 points, so the pre-registered decision rule fails. Physically the 20 kPa sheet thrust does not build a sail in this model: it drives a thin, fast-moving ribbon of blocks against the structure (pile mass drops by 3-4x) while the front load rises by 1.2-3.5x. A sail needs interlocking (angular, non-spherical, freeze-bonded blocks); with friction-only spheres the emergent heap cannot stand above one block diameter.
D1_sheet_thrust_as_sail_mechanism.consequence: The height observable H_p is declared NOT RESOLVED by this model and the steady-geometry scaling claim (criterion (b)) is WITHHELD rather than silently restated. The thrust boundary is kept in the campaign grid, but strictly as a *load* mechanism (a paired treatment over the Fr/C_i space), never as a sail mechanism.

implementation_defect_found_and_fixed_du.symptom: first thrust implementation (per-block sigma (2r)^2 applied to every block in the feed band, no speed condition) gave p_front = 6.2-16.5 kPa, 1.4-3.1 m block launches and empty resident sets (log: logs/exp1.log, amendment-1 run)
implementation_defect_found_and_fixed_du.cause: a pressure boundary applied to a dilute stream pumps energy: the per-block force (528 N for r = 0.081 m) is ~26x the block weight and nothing limits the resulting speed
implementation_defect_found_and_fixed_du.fix: the thrust acts only while v_x < v_i: an ice sheet drifting at v_i cannot accelerate a block beyond its own speed, so the term transmits a jam pressure instead of injecting kinetic energy
implementation_defect_found_and_fixed_du.evidence: logs/exp_thrust2.log (the capped version): p_front back to 0.6-1.2 kPa, no launches, H_p/(2r) in 0.39-0.52

D2_dual_shielding_baseline.rule: amendment 1: R_shield_A (momentum-flux baseline) finite for all pairs and R_shield_B (cleared-cylinder twin) finite wherever p0 > 0, with the sign agreement reported
D2_dual_shielding_baseline.sweeper_defect_found: the cleared-cylinder twin removed a block on its first contact with the structure, and the stored amendment-0 artifacts showed p0 = 0 in every twin (artifacts/rubble_accumulation/sweep.json: all 13 sweeper rows), which made R_shield undefined everywhere
D2_dual_shielding_baseline.fix: the twin now removes a block only after it has been resident (|v| < 0.5 v_i) inside the removal shell for sweep_dwell_time = 0.05 s, so contacts deliver their impulse before the block disappears; the removal shell is R + 1.02 r (block radii beyond the surface), not the capture-zone radius
D2_dual_shielding_baseline.evidence: logs/exp_sweep.log: p0 = 94.7 Pa (C_i=0.3, v_i=0.3) and 625.6 Pa (C_i=0.5, v_i=1.0), no longer zero
D2_dual_shielding_baseline.notice: the amendment-0 artifacts were produced by an earlier revision of the sweeper and are superseded by this run; they are kept only as the record of the defect

decision_records.definition_note_resident_filter: the pre-registered pile definition (|v| < 0.5 v_i inside the capture shell) is NOT changed. Under the 20 kPa thrust it under-reports the pile, because a driven jam is in motion: the thrust rows therefore carry a smaller pile mass and a smaller L_p than the reference rows at the same load. This is reported as a limitation of the metric, not corrected after the fact.

main_design.drive_of_the_reference_cases: mass-flux feed at the inlet + horizontal water drag towards v_i, no thrust pressure (thrust_pressure = 0)
main_design.G4_cleared_cylinder_twins: one twin per G1 and G3 case (13 cases)
main_design.G5_negative_controls: C_i = 0 (v_i = 0.3) and v_i = 0 (C_i = 0.3) at the G1 centre point (2 cases)
main_design.G6_block_size_sensitivity: G1 centre point at particle budget 1200 and 12000 (2 cases)
main_design.G7_thrust_treatment: the G1 core re-run with the 20 kPa sheet pressure ON, paired (9 cases)
main_design.budget: particle budget 3000 (blocks sized by h_i/(2*layer_target), raised if the budget is exceeded), 9000 steps max per case, samples 200, seed 0
main_design.stopping_rule: each case runs to min(9000 steps, time_factor*flux_time_scale + 0.5 transit); no case is extended or reseeded because of its result
main_design.thresholds: unchanged from amendment 0 (growth R^2 > 0.95, scaling exponents within 20 % of literature where a literature value exists, mass closure < 2 %, negative controls exactly zero, pytest >= 10)

analysis_notes: the growth-law fit window is the pre-registered rule (start when the signal first exceeds 2 % of its run maximum), with a fixed 11-sample centred moving average reported alongside the raw fit

criterion (b) is decided WITHHELD: no authoritative literature value exists for the Fr/C_i exponents of B_inf/D, H_inf/h_i or L_inf/D around a cylinder in a broken-ice field, so the exponents are reported as measured ranges and standard errors only
criteria are decided one observable at a time; one FAIL does not overwrite another observable's result
